output.sql:
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(SUM(ol.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue,
       ROUND(SUM(ol.net_amount) - SUM(ol.cogs), 2) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(ol.net_amount) - SUM(ol.cogs)) / NULLIF(SUM(ol.net_amount), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM marts.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC;
output.explanation: This query works out gross margin percent for each product category in 2025, using order lines. For each category it calculates (sum of net_amount − sum of cogs) ÷ sum of net_amount × 100. Only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue = true) with an order date in 2025 are counted. Net revenue and gross margin are also returned as totals for context. All values are rounded to 2 decimals, and results are sorted from highest to lowest margin percent. Shipping fees aren't included because they're recorded per order, not per product line.
